༄༅/ /chos dbyings gsung dbang gi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs zhal mthong bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos dbyings gsung dbang gi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs zhal mthong bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes sku/ /nam mkha' dri med smra ba che/ /chos dbyings gsung dbang la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'di/ bla ma kha cig rgyud sde lnga pa spyi yi rgyud du bzhed pa yang yod mod kyi| dbang bzhi pa'i nges don mthar thug brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pas sngags bla med kyi nang nas kyang gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud du bzhed pa ni shin tu legs pa yin no// slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis gsang 'dus dang grub chen ḍoṃ bi he ru kas bde mchog tu yang bkral la/ rnal 'byor rgyud du 'grel bar mdzad pa'i mkhas pa ni shin tu yang mang bas yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa bod du 'gyur ba yang bcu drug tsam yod do/ / yo gar bkral ba thams cad kyang bsdu na lugs chen po bzhir grags te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa'i mtshan brjod rgya cher 'grel la brten nas nam mkha' dri med ces par grags pa chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ slob dpon sgeg rdaur gyi 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs la brten nas 'grel pa bar ma'i lugs su grags pa gsang ldan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi 'grel chung la brten nas 'grel chung lugs su grags pa nam mkha' dri med chung ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon a ba dhū tī pa'i 'grel pa la brten nas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /bar pa gnyis dang sgo bstun pa'i bla med kyi nyams len ni ma mthong la/ /tha ma dang bstun pa ni/ dus 'khor dang*| phreng bar 'byung ngo/ /'dir ni/ dang pau'i lha sngags/ bla med kyi lam gyis nyams su len par mkhas pa a bha ā ka ras bshad pa bzhin du/

mtshan brjod thugs dam du byed pa'i sngags bla med kyi rnal 'byor pa mkhas rmongs kun la phan pa zhig brjod pa bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro dang*/ yig brgya sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa sngon du btang ba'am/ ma btang pa yang rung ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i maṃ yig dmar ser las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i mchod yul thams cad chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bor spyan drangs/ oṃbha ga wan dz+nyā na mūrti wa gī shwa ra ma hā wa tsa sarba dharma ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shung+ngha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ buṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+da rū pa shap+da gan+dha ra sa spar+sha dharma dha tu pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī? āḥhūm̐/ 'dud nyi shus bstod/ gang gis thogs med srid pa'i chu klung du/ / zhes pa nas/ da ni gnas par bgyi/ tshogs zhing rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra sā bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur| stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gi rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas skor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi phreng ba phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i phyogs mtshams gyi rtsibs brgyad kyi steng gi nam mkha' dang steng 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang la cung zad ma reg pa rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bcu 'khod pa ni shar du ma he'i gdan la gshin rje'i gshed/ mdog nag zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug 'jigs| |g.yas gsum lcags kyu ral gri mda' dang g.yon/ /zhags pa gzhu dang dril bu 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /lho ru shes rab mthar byed ser sngau dkar// dmar ba'i zhal ldan g.yas bzhi zhags pa dang*/ /ral gri rdo rje mda' 'dzin g.yon lcags kyu/

/dril bu mdung dang gzhu 'dzin khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar sngau ljang*/ /dkar ba'i zhal ldan phyag gnyis lcags sgrogs 'ching*| |g.yas gsum ral gri lcags kyu mda' dang g.yon/ /sdig mdzub gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /byang du bgegs mthar byaid sngo sngo dkar dmar| |ljang ba'i zhal bzhi phyag gnyis rdor dril :sdom [ snam ] / g.yas gsum ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu g.yon/ /zhags pa gzhu dang dril bu 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /drag po khams gsum rnam rgyal sngau dmar ljang*/ /dkar ba'i zhal bzhi rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad 'ching*/ /g.yas gsum ral gri lcags kyu mda' rnams dang*| |g.yon gsum gzhu dang zhags pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon rkyang dbang phyug yab yum mnan phyag 'tshal/ /me mtshams me ltar 'bar sngo dkar ljang dmar// rdo rje ral gri mda' dang 'khor lo g.yas/ /dril bu zhags pa gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon| |g.yas rkyang khyab 'jug yab yum mnan phyag 'tshal/ /srin por khrag 'thung sngo dmar ljang dkar zhal/ /rdor dril kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis gar bsgyur zhing*/ / glang lpags mda' gzhu sha khrag thod pa 'dzin/ g.yon brkyang tshangs pa yab yum mnan phyag 'tshal/ /rlung du rta mchog ljang dkar dmar ser zhal/ /ba dan gsum pas sna tshogs rdo rje bsgreng*/ /ba dan gsum tshul ral gri mda' rnams g.yas| kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung dang dbyug pa gzhu rnams g.yon/ /dbang por dpal mo dga' ma tshim ma dang*/ /brgya byin khyab 'jug rgyal byed dpy-id kyi lha/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang zhabs bzhis mnan phyag 'tshal/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser/ /ser dkar sngo dmar zhal bzhi phyag brgyad g.yas// 'khor lo ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu g.yon/ /sdig mdzub gzhu zhags dril bu 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po sku mdog sngo/ /sngo dkar dmar ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad g.yas/ /rdo rje ral gri mda' dang dgra sta g.yon| |sdig 'dzub gzhu zhags be con 'dzin phyag 'tshal/

khrau bo gzhan lnga g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ /kun kyang sna tshogs pad nyir 'jigs pa'i gzugs| khro bo'i nyams ldan sbrul dang stag lpags can/ /gtum chen khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung 'khor de'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs shing rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa| |de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba yangs pa'i steng du rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zluṃ po sgo bzhi pa/ /de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i nang du phyed kyi tshad kyi gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor te| de gsum gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ bzhi ka'ang phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa rtsig pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang me long dang rnga yab dang me tog gi phreng ba rnams kyis mdzes pa/ bya 'dab la 'phyang ba'i shar bu dang de'i steng du 'da' yab dang de'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang zur bzhir gdugs kyis mdzes pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon kyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ dkyil 'khor phyi sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis stegs pa'i rta bab snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pa zlum por bskor ba la rten pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis stegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i taug gis spras ba lha dang mi las yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dam pa phyi bltas nang gsal ba nang bltas phyi gsal ba nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba'i nang gi ling tshe dgu'i dbus ma'i dbus su seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sogs pa gdan thams cad kyang rdzogs par grub pa'i steng du lha nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa dus gcig tu grub pa ni/

dbus su rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dbang phyug ni gser sbyangs gtso ma'i lhun po'i dpal la nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /zhal bzhi g.yas bskor ser sngo dmar ljang 'dzum sgeg zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /phyag brgyad g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis kyi thugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgya/ /de 'og gnyis kyis ral gri glegs bam gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /bzhi pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /blo ldan sgeg 'chang dpal ldan zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil dkrung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skra mchog mthon ka chen po'i ngos la zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i dbang po sna tshogs rdo rjes legs mtshan pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan snyam rgyan mgul rgyan dpung rgyan gdu bu do shal dang*/ /ske rags bzang po lha rdzas nam bza' sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /dpal ldan khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' dri med la phyag 'tshal/ /shar sogs bzhi dang dbang ldan la sogs bzhir/ /seng ge'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /gtsug tor chen po'i gzi brjid phung po dang*| |gdugs dkar rnam rgyal rnam 'thor 'phags pa dang*/ /cher 'phags rgyal ba kun kyang gser mdog can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kun 'khor lo bsgreng*/ /g.yon pa gdan steng rdo rje dkyil krungs bzhugs/ /gtsug tor chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar du glang chen khri la mi skyod sngo/ /sngo dkar dmar ljang zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'jigs/ /ral gri rdo rje mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas/ /sdigs mdzub dril bu gzhu dang zhags pa g.yon/ /lho ru rta yi khri la rin 'byung ser/ /ser sngo dmar ljang zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'dzum/ /rdo rje ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas/ /rgyal mtshan dril bu gzhu dang zhags pa g.yon| |nub tu rma bya'i khri la dpag med dmar/

/dmar sngo ser ljang zhal bzhi phyag brgyad chags/ /rdo rje ral gri mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas/ pad+ma zhags pa gzhu dang dril bu g.yon/ /byang du mkha' lding khri la don grub ljang*/ /ljang dkar dmar ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad sgeg /ral gri rdo rje mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas| |sdigs mdzub dril bu gzhu dang zhags pa g.yon/ /sna tshogs pad nyir rdo rje dkyil dkrungs bzhugs/ /gtso chen rgyal ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang ldan la sogs bzhir/ /rdor sems dkar po rdo rje thugs kar stod/ /rdo rje rgyal ser rdo rje lcags kyu 'gugs/ /rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu bgengs/ /rdo rje legs pa ljang khu legs so stair/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbang ldan la sogs bzhir/ /rdo rje rin chen ser po rin chen 'ching*/ /rdo rje nyi ma dmar po thugs kar nyi/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan ljang khu rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so 'phreng 'phyar/ /'od dpag med kyi dbang ldan la sogs bzhir/ /rdo rje chos dmar pad+ma'i sdong po 'byed/ /rdo rje rno sngo ral gri glegs bam 'dzin/ /rdo rje rgyu ser thugs kar 'khor lo'i rgya/ /rdo rje smra bar dmar po rdo rje'i ljags/ /don yod grub pa'i dbang ldan la sogs bzhir/ /rdo rje las ljang sna tshogs rdo rje gtod/ /rdo rje bsrung ba ser po go cha bgo /rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mche ba'i rgya/ /rdo rje khu tshur dkar po rdo rje'i 'ching*/ /sna tshogs pad zlar sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs bzhugs/ /rigs bzhi'i sems dpa' bcu drug la phyag 'tshal/ /dbang ldan spyan ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mtshungs| |me mtshams ma ma kī ni mi bskyod 'dra/ /srin po gos dkar 'od dpag med pa bzhin/ /rlung mtshams sgrol ma don grub lta bu ste/ sna tshogs pad zlar rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung bzhugs/ /rigs kyi yum chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal

lo| |sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril/ /sngo ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu 'dzin| khro bo'i nyams ldan sna chogs pad nyi la/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum pos bzhugs/ sgo skyong khro bo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa gzungs dkyil lha rnams la/ /shar du sa'i lha mo bcu gnyis ni| |g.yas kun rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon rnams kyis/ /mos spyod dmar mo pad+ma dmar po 'dzin/ /rab dga' ser mo nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dri med dkar mo chu skyes dkar po 'dzin/ /'od byed dmar mo pad steng nyi ma 'dzin/ / 'od 'phro ljang khu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /sbyang dka' dmar mo mnyam gzhag nor bu 'dzin/ /mngon 'gyur ser mo pad steng glegs bam 'dzin/ /ring song sngo sangs pad steng sna tshogs rdor/ /mi g.yo dkar mo pad steng rdo rje dmar/ / legs blo dmar skya ut+pal ral gri 'dzin/ /chos sprin ser mo sprin seb glegs bam 'dzin/ /kun 'od dmar mo pad steng bde gshegs sku/ /rtogs pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /lho ru phar phyin lha mo bcu gnyis ni/ /g.yas kun rgyal mtshan 'phyar zhing g.yon rnams kyis/ /rin chen pad+ma'i pha rol phyin ma dmar| |pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin/ /spyan ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin/ /tshul khrims dkar mo mya ngan med yal ga/bzod pa ser mo chu skyes dkar mo 'dzin/ /brtson 'grus ljang khu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /bsam gtan sngo sangs pad+ma dkar po 'dzin/ /sher phyin ser mo pad steng glegs bam 'dzin| |dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar chos 'khor rgya/ /thabs ljang spri yang ku yi me tog 'dzin/ /smon lam sngon mo ut+pal ral gri 'dzin/ /stobs kyi phar phyin dmar mo pad dkar 'dzin/ /ye shes dkar mo rin chen byang chub shing*/ / rdo rje las kyi pha rol phy-in ma ljang*/

/pad+ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /spyod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /nub tu dbang gi lha mo bcu gnyis ni/ / g.yas kun pad+ma 'phyar zhing g.yon rnams kyis/ /tshe dbang mar mo tshe dpag med sku 'dzin/ /sems la dbang ba dkar mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /yo byad ser mo rin chen snye ma 'dzin/ /las dbang ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /skye dbang sna tshogs sna ma'i me tog 'dzin/ /rdzu 'phrul ljang khu pad steng nyi zla 'dzin/ /mos dkar spri yang ku yi me tog 'dzin/ /smon lam ser mo ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /ye shes sngon po ut+pal ral gri 'dzin/ /chos dbang dmar skya pad steng bum bzang 'dzin| |de bzhin nyid dkar rin chen yal ga 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ser mo rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa rgyal mtshan steng du 'khor lo 'dzin/ /yon tan lha mo bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /byang du gzungs kyi lha mo bcu gnyis ni/ / g.yas kun sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon rnams kyis/ /nor gyi gzungs ma ser mo snye ma 'dzin/ /rin chen skar zla dmar po rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /rnam rgyal dmar mo shel gyi bum pa 'dzin/ /'khor lo can ser khab dang skud pa 'dzin/ /lo ma gyon ljang rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dzin/ /dug sel dkar mo dug gi me tog 'dzin/ / sgo mtha' yas ljang pad steng gter bum 'dzin/ /tsun da dkar mo phreng 'phyang bum pa 'dzin/ /shel 'phel dkar mo ut+pal ral gri 'dzin/ /sgrib sel ljang mo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /za ma tog dmar rin chen za ma tog /chos mdzod ser mo sna tshogs dpe sgrom 'dzin/ /blo gros lha mo bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /me mtshams sogs bzhir sgeg mo phreng ba ma/ /glu ma gar ma dmar ser dmar ljang mdog |snyems tshul phreng ba pi waṃ rdo rje 'dzin/ /sgo bzhir chos dang don dang nges tshig dang*/ /spobs pa so so yang dag rig ma rnams/ /dmar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu zhags sogs 'dzin/

/sher phyin las gzhan zhal cig phyag gnyis ma/ /kun kyang rab mdzes lha mo 'dzum sgeg zhi/ /sna tshogs pad zlar sems pa'i dkyil dkrung bzhugs/ /gzugs dkyil nga drug lha mo la phyag 'tshal| |dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i lha rnams la/ /shar du kun bzang ser po g.yas| |mchog sbyin ut+pal ral gri g.yon/ /blo gros mi zad ser po g.yas// skyabs sbyin ral gri spyi blugs g.yon/ /sa snying ser po sa gnon g.yas/ /pad steng dpag bsam ljon pa g.yon/ /mkha' snying ljang khu rin chen char/ /g.yon pas nor bu'i rgyan mtshan 'dzin/ /lho ru mkha' mdzod ser po g.yas/ /rin chen pad steng dpag bsam g.yon/ /phyag na rin chen ljang khu g.yas/ /nor bu pad steng zla ba g.yon/ /blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas/ /dung dkar dang ni rdo rje g.yon/ /rdor snying sngon po rdo rje g.yas/ /mdo sde sa bcu'i po ti g.yon/ / nub tu spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar/ /g.yas g.yon mchog sbyin pad dkar 'dzin| |mthu chen thob ser ral gri g.yas/ /g.yon pa chu skyes dkar po 'dzin| |zla 'od dkar po 'khor lo g.yas/ /g.yon pa pad steng zla ba 'dzin// dra ba can 'od dmar po g.yas/ /ral gri pad steng nyi ma g.yon/ /byang du 'od dpag med dkar g.yas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma bum pa g.yon/ /spobs pa brtsegs ser se gol g.yas/ /g.yon pas ut+pal ral gri 'dzin/ /mya ngan mun 'joms dmar ser g.yas/ /dung dkar dang ni mdung thung g.yon/ /sgrib sel ljang khu ral gri g.yas/ /g.yon pas sna tshogs ba dan 'dzin/ /sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /rab mdzes sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs bzhugs/ /skal bzang sems pa la phyag 'tshal/ khro bcu sngar bzhin la shar sgor zhes sogs sbyar nas brjod/ me sogs zur bzhi'i g.yas dang g.yon gnyis su/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri mchog ma/ /gzugs sgra ro reg mar ser dmar ljang mdog/pad zlar sems dkyil rang rtags 'dzin phyag 'tshal/

/gtso 'khor thams cad rang snang thabs shes sbyor/ /bde ba chen po'i dpal la rtag tu rol// zhi ba'i 'khor kun rin chen rgyan brgya dang/ /lha rdzas nam bzas klubs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhi pa rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar du brgya byin ser po glang chen la zhon pa rdo rje dang nu ma 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa g.yas gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang dbyug gu/ g.yon gnyis blugs bzar dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug pa dang be con 'dzin pa/ lho nub du srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po gdeng ka bdun ldan chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags dang dung dkar 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha ljang sngon ri dwags la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po mi la zhon pa dbyug pa dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/

dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa ral pa'i thor tshugs dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan zhing rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing 'og ma gnyis kyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan bzung nas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol du dbang ldan gyi zur nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor du rim pa bzhin du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyi pad ma dang dbyug gu 'dzin pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing 'og ma gnyis kyi phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ khyab 'jug nag po nam mkha' lding la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi yi dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang shu rang ga'i gzhu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbang phyug chen po dkar po glang la zhon pa ral pa'i tho tshugs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gzhon nu gdong drug dmar po rma bya la zhon pa gzhon nu'i tshul can zhal drug phyag drug gi dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing bar pa gnyis kyis rdor dril bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa 'og ma gnyis kyis khyim bya dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ tshangs ma dang khyab 'jug ma dang drag mo dang gzhon nu ma dang dbang mo rnams kyang rang rang gi yab dang mtshungs ba'i zhal phyag dang ldan zhing zhon pa la gnas pa| phag mo nag mo yi dwags dmar po la gnas shing nya rlon pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ tsa muṇ+ḍa nag mo shin tu skem pa yi dwags la gnas shing gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po byi ba la gnas shing g.yas gnyis la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis la dung dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/

nag po chen po nag po rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dga' byed dbang phyug nag po rdza rnga zhon pas rdza rnga brdung pa bh+riṃ gi ri ti nag po thal mo sbyar zhing phreng ba dang sbyi blug 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs ba'i shing rta la gnas shing pad ma'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ zla ba dkar po dang bas drangs ba'i shing rta la gnas shing ku mu ta'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ mig dmar dmar po ra skyes la gnas shing ral gri dang mi mgo 'dzin pa/ lhag pa ljang khu pad+ma la gnas shing mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ phur bu ser po glang chen la gnas shing phreng ba dang sbyi blugs 'dzin pa/ pa sangs dkar po bum pa la gnas shing shel phreng dang sbyi blugs 'dzin pa/ spen pa nag po rus sbal la gnas shing ral gri dang dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ sgra gcan dmar nag brag ri la gnas shing nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa/ mjug rings dkar po sbrul la gnas shing ral gri dang sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ stobs bzang dkar po glang la gnas shing ral gri dang thong gshol 'dzin pa/ rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu khu byug la gnas shing g.yas gnyis phreng ba dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis khaṃ phor dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po ne tso dang dpyid kyi lha dkar po spri'u la gnas shing*/ de gnyis kyi g.yas dang po gnyis rgyal mtshan dang ral gri/ gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dmar po/ nor rgyas ser po/ 'jog po nag po/ pad ma dang stobs rgyu dkar po/ pad chen nag po/ dung skyong ser po/ rigs ldan ljang khu/ thams cad kyang stod lha'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thag bzang ris dang stobs ldan dang rab dga' dang rnam par snang byed de bzhi ka'ang shing rta la gnas shing ral gri dang phub la sogs pa'i go mtshon sna tshogs thogs nas g.yul du zhugs pa/

nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gshog pa brkyang pa rkang pa nas spyi'i bar du ser po/ spyi nas lte ba'i bar du dkar po/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar du dmar po/ mgrin pa nas dpral ba'i bar du nag po/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba brgyangs nas 'dzin pa/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can dmar skya dang dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa gser mdog gnyis pi waṃ sgrogs pa la brtson pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po don kun grub pa dkar po phreng ba 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang po sngon po/ gang ba bzang po ser po/ nor sbyin dmar po/ rnam thos kyi bu ser po/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po/ /kī li mā li ljang khu/ sgo'i dbang po dang spyod pa'i dbang po ser po/ thams cad kyang lus sbaum zhing thung ba g.yas bī dza pū ra dang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ 'phrog ma ser mo bu lnga dang bcas pa zan gyi chang bu 'dzin pa/ smin drug sngo sangs/ snar ma dmar skya/ mgo nag mo/ lag dang nam so ser mo/ rgyal sngo sangs/ skag dkar mo/ mchu ser po gre ljang ser/ dbo ljang khu/ me bzhi dkar po/ /nag pa ljang khu/ sa ri ser po/ sa ga nag mo/ lha mtshams ljang khu| snon dang snubs ser mo/ chu stod nag mo/ chu smad dkar mo/ gro zhun dkar ser| byin zhin sngo sangs/ mon gre nag mo/ mon gru ser mo/ khrums stod ljang khu| khrums smad ser mo/ nam gru dkar ser/ tha dkar dkar mo/ bra nye ljang khu| de thams cad kyang lha mo stod g.yogs g.yo ba dang bcas pa/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba stan nang tshangs can la gnas pa/ tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pa lha'i gtso bo thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te/ phyogs bcur snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa la brtson pa/ sgo bzhir rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba'am/

sgo bzhir rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ shar tu rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung mar gad kyi mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gṛ dang gdan la bsten pa grul bum gyi/ nub tu spyan mi bzang dmar po sprul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa klu'i/ byang du rnam thos kyi sras ser po be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ gtso bo'i thugs kar maṃ yig gser gyi mdog can gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ mchod bstod tshogs zhing ltar byas/ bzlas pa mtshan brjod kyi sngags 'og ma'i a āḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs bzla/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo mtshan brjod nyid la bya'o// 'di ni sku gsum lam khyer gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la sogs pa snang ba thams cad rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi rnam rol du 'char ba'i rnal 'byor pa mchog gi nyams len rnal 'byor rdzaugs pa'i phreng ba dang bstun pa yin la/ las dang po pas rgyas par nyams su len na/ ye shes zhabs lugs dang sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ 'jam rdor gyi mngon rtogs ji bzhin la 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ /spo rgyu ni/ bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang 'dir bshad pa ji bzhin bya/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum la/ ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug ni/ zhes dang| dbang phyug ma/ zhes sbyar/ mig gnyis su mig dbang gi rang bzhin zhes sogs khyad med du sbyar/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ thig le dri ma med pa maṃ yig dmar ser gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa rnams re re nas gtso bo'i thugs kar drangs/ mtshan sngags dang rtsa rigs la sogs pa'i 'byin sngags so sos phyung*/

phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ spyi dgos kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ slar 'dus te gtso bo rang la thim pa'i 'khor rnams rang rang gi gnas su 'khod pa ni/ shar sogs bzhi dang dbang ldan sogs sbyar ro/ /thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ji ltar bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs zhes sogs ji bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor 'di ni mtshan brjod la rten pa'i nyams len gyi gtso bo rgya bod na nyi zla ltar grags pa rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor che tshad dang dka' ba'i tshad du grags shing grub pa 'di/ shog gu bzhi la tshang bar 'dus pa 'di ni kho bo'i blaus lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba yin pas don du gnyer par bya'o/ /'di rnal 'byor rgyud la brten nas nyams su len tshul ni gzhan du brjod par bya'o/ / 'jams dbyangs sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /dge slong lha yi skad rigs pa/ /pra dz+nyā rat+nas sbyar ba yin/ /dge bas 'jam dbyangs myur grub shog/ // shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /spar la bkod pa'i bzo rigs mthun rkyen sogs/ /rin chen bsam grub ces byas sbyar pa yin| |ye ge pa ni tshul khrims 'phel nyid do/ / rdzogs so// //bkra shis shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/chos dbyings gsung dbang gi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs zhal mthong*/ -PAGE 18--PAGE 19-- PAGE 3-
